vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mosaic-video-editor
Version: 1.2.0

The mosaic-video-editor skill bundle is a legitimate integration for the Mosaic AI video editing platform. It provides comprehensive documentation and instructions for an AI agent to manage video workflows, upload assets, and publish to social media via the api.mosaic.so endpoints. There is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration to unauthorized domains, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (controlling the Mosaic video API) matches the required credential and the runtime instructions; nothing requested or documented appears unrelated to video editing, asset uploads, agent runs, or social publishing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, required env var (MOSAIC_API_KEY), and the listed endpoints and workflows all align with Mosaic's video-editing and social-publishing functionality. There are no unrelated credentials, binaries, or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions stay within the Mosaic API: checking/asking for MOSAIC_API_KEY, validating via a whoami call, using documented endpoints for agents, uploads, and social publishing. Note: the SKILL explicitly tells the agent to 'store the key as MOSAIC_API_KEY in your environment for future sessions' — this is reasonable for convenience but means the agent will persist a secret in its environment if implemented; users should ensure the platform stores secrets securely.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec or external downloads. Lowest-risk install profile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only a single API credential (MOSAIC_API_KEY) is required and it is the primary credential appropriate for the described API operations. No unrelated secrets or broad environment access are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true or elevated privileges. It does recommend persisting the MOSAIC_API_KEY in the agent environment for future sessions — this is convenient but effectively gives the skill long-lived access to the user's Mosaic account if stored. Users should be aware of that persistence and control where/ how the key is stored.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent for controlling Mosaic's API, but before installing: (1) confirm you trust https://edit.mosaic.so and generate an API key with least privileges needed; (2) avoid pasting the API key into public chat — provide it via the platform's secure credential mechanism if available; (3) recognize the skill asks to persist the key in the agent environment — ensure the environment stores secrets securely and rotate the key if you later uninstall or suspect compromise; (4) review any social-account connections the skill will initiate, since posting/publishing actions can publish content on your behalf.
